acxii-acne-brightening-soap.heading: Why it is on the shelf
acxii-acne-brightening-soap.lead:
Half the people who ask us about breakouts have a drawer of half-used serums and no cleanser worth the name. A bar with an active in it is the cheapest change to make, and the easiest one to keep up.

What it replaces is the third serum. Most routines aimed at breakout-prone skin get longer and more expensive without touching the step that happens every single day, and a cleanser is the only thing everybody already does. At sixteen dollars it is the lowest-risk thing to change in a routine that is not working.
ways: Evening — as the second cleanse, after an oil has taken off sunscreen and makeup.
Body — on the back and shoulders, where breakouts are common and most people never treat them.
Travel — a bar does not count as a liquid, which is most of why it lives in a wash bag.
acxii-acne-brightening-soap.before: Start at once a day rather than twice. A korean cleansing bar with an active in it is easy to overdo, and dry, tight skin an hour later is the sign that you have. Follow with a moisturiser every time, and wear sunscreen the next morning — a salicylic acid soap makes skin more sensitive to daylight, and tone work undone by UV is wasted. If your skin is already peeling from something else, give it a week off before you start.
acxii-acne-brightening-soap.lead_base: Half the people who ask us about breakouts have a drawer of half-used serums and no cleanser worth the name. A bar with an active in it is the cheapest change to make, and the easiest one to keep up.

ahc-premier-ampoule-in-eye-cream-40ml-1-.heading: Why it is on the shelf
ahc-premier-ampoule-in-eye-cream-40ml-1-.lead:
Most eye creams come in a pot the size of a thimble and run out before you know whether they work. This one is large enough to use twice a day for months, which is the only way to find out.

The reason most people cannot say whether an eye cream worked is that they never finished one. A thimble-sized pot rations itself and a verdict arrives at about week three, which is too early for anything honest. This one is priced and sized so the question can actually be answered — which is a strange thing to say about a korean eye cream and the main reason we carry it.
ways: Morning — a grain of rice per eye, patted in with the ring finger before sunscreen.
Night — the same again, as the last step, which is when most of the work happens.
All over — the tube is large enough that most people end up using it on the whole face.
ahc-premier-ampoule-in-eye-cream-40ml-1-.before: A korean eye cream is a long game. Give it eight weeks before you decide anything, and do not expect a collagen eye cream to do what a filler does — the honest claim is on the appearance of fine lines, not on the lines themselves. Pat, never drag, and stay outside the orbital bone: product migrates towards the eye on its own overnight, and starting too close is how people wake up puffy. If your eyes are sensitive, patch it on the inner wrist for a night first.
ahc-premier-ampoule-in-eye-cream-40ml-1-.lead_base: Most eye creams come in a pot the size of a thimble and run out before you know whether they work. This one is large enough to use twice a day for months, which is the only way to find out.

ampoule-sheet-mask.heading: Why it is on the shelf
ampoule-sheet-mask.lead:
Sold one at a time, so you can work through the range and find the one that suits you rather than committing to a box of ten. Twenty minutes is the whole commitment.

Buying a box of ten of the wrong mask is how most people decide the whole category does nothing. Sold singly, finding out costs four dollars rather than twenty-five — and korean skincare is mostly a matter of finding out, which is cheaper to do a sachet at a time than a bottle at a time.
ways: Routine — over a cleansed, toned face for fifteen to twenty minutes.
Afterwards — press in what is left rather than rinsing, then moisturise.
Frequency — twice a week is plenty; nightly is not better.
ampoule-sheet-mask.before: Five kinds, and they are not interchangeable: cica for skin that is reacting, hyaluronic acid for dehydration, vitamin for dullness, arbutin for tone, tea tree for breakouts. Buy for the thing you actually have rather than one of each. Leaving a korean sheet mask on until it dries works against you — once the sheet is dry it pulls moisture back out, so take it off while it is still damp.
ampoule-sheet-mask.lead_base: Sold one at a time, so you can work through the range and find the one that suits you rather than committing to a box of ten. Twenty minutes is the whole commitment.

anjo-professional-365-70g.heading: Why it is on the shelf
anjo-professional-365-70g.lead:
The best sunscreen is the one you will put on tomorrow as well. This is the plain, untinted, no-argument version for anyone who has given up on the ones that sit grey on the skin.

Nothing on a shelf protects anybody. The only sunscreen that works is the one that gets used on a grey Tuesday in March as well as on a beach, and that is a question of texture and price rather than ingredients. This is the tube we hand to people who have decided the whole category is not for them.
ways: Every morning — the last step before makeup, two fingers' length for face and neck.
Through the day — again every two or three hours if you are out in it.
On the move — the large tube is for home; decant a little if you are out all day.
anjo-professional-365-70g.before: A daily sunscreen only works at the quantity it was tested at, which is about two fingers' length for a face and neck — most people use half that and get half the protection. This is the untinted one, so there is nothing to match to your skin and nothing to blend. If you have found a korean sun cream too heavy before, this is the lighter end of the shelf. Keep it out of a hot car; heat degrades the filters faster than time does.
anjo-professional-365-70g.lead_base: The best sunscreen is the one you will put on tomorrow as well. This is the plain, untinted, no-argument version for anyone who has given up on the ones that sit grey on the skin.

anjo-professional-365-sun-bb-cream-spf50.heading: Why it is on the shelf
anjo-professional-365-sun-bb-cream-spf50.lead:
Two steps collapse into one, which is the difference between wearing sunscreen every day and wearing it when you remember. The tint is light enough that it is a base rather than a decision.

It is aimed at the morning that has seven minutes in it. Two steps become one, and the step that usually gets dropped when time is short is the protective one — so collapsing it into the cosmetic one is not laziness, it is the only version that survives a real week. A tinted sunscreen is a habit disguised as a shortcut.
ways: Bare face — on its own, as the only thing between a cleansed face and the door.
Under a base — as the primer step, where the shea butter stops foundation breaking up.
Top-up — pressed over makeup at four o'clock rather than rubbed in.
anjo-professional-365-sun-bb-cream-spf50.before: One shade, pitched at the middle of the range and sheer enough to adjust itself on most skin. If you wear a foundation darker than medium, treat this as a base rather than as coverage. A sun bb cream is still a sunscreen: it needs reapplying, and nothing survives six hours of daylight on one coat. Shake it before the first use of the day, because the tint settles.
anjo-professional-365-sun-bb-cream-spf50.lead_base: Two steps collapse into one, which is the difference between wearing sunscreen every day and wearing it when you remember. The tint is light enough that it is a base rather than a decision.

artisan-ribbed-knit-midi-dress.heading: Why we took this one
artisan-ribbed-knit-midi-dress.lead:
We buy very few dresses that come with a second piece, because most detachable things look detachable. This vest does not — and taken off, it is a good vest in its own right, which is really two purchases for one.

Two pieces that only work together are one purchase; two that work apart are three outfits. Almost all of them fail it, because the extra piece is cut to flatter what it came with and nothing else. This vest goes over jeans on its own, which is how it ends up being worn most.
ways: September — vest on, ankle boots, bare legs, nothing else needed.
January — vest on, opaque tights, tall boots and a long coat over the top.
Office — vest off, a blazer over the dress, a flat loafer underneath.
artisan-ribbed-knit-midi-dress.before: Sized S–M, and the knit has real give, so the span it covers is wider than the label suggests. The waist is elastic rather than seamed, which means it sits where your waist actually is. As a petite dress long sleeve shape it needs no alteration — the sleeve ends at the wrist on a shorter frame rather than past it, which is the change most knit dresses need. Buy it for the dress and treat the vest as the second purchase; plenty of people here do it the other way round.
artisan-ribbed-knit-midi-dress.lead_base: We buy very few dresses that come with a second piece, because most detachable things look detachable. This vest does not — and taken off, it is a good vest in its own right, which is really two purchases for one.

asymmetrical-tartan-pleated-midi-skirt.heading: Why we took this one
asymmetrical-tartan-pleated-midi-skirt.lead:
A plain tartan skirt is a plain tartan skirt. The pleated panel down one side is the whole reason this one came back with us: standing still it is heritage, walking it is something else entirely.

Tartan returns every few autumns and then quietly stays, which makes it worth buying once and properly rather than cheaply and often. The asymmetry is what stops this reading as a uniform skirt — a flat front, a pleated side, and a different shape depending on whether you are sitting or walking. For petite clothes for work it does the serious job without a jacket.
ways: Daytime — a plain cream knit, ankle boots, and nothing else patterned anywhere.
Work — a fine black polo neck tucked in, flat loafers, a plain coat.
Evening — a black top and a heel, with the violet in the plaid picked up in a bag.
asymmetrical-tartan-pleated-midi-skirt.before: Two sizes on the waist, and there is no stretch in the waistband — take the larger of the two if you are between them. At 27.5 inches the hem sits below the knee on most people and at mid-calf if you are petite, which suits the pleated panel rather than fighting it. This is a korean fashion skirt that does the talking, so keep everything above it plain. Dry clean, or wash cold in a mesh bag and hang by the waistband so the pleats fall straight.
asymmetrical-tartan-pleated-midi-skirt.lead_base: A plain tartan skirt is a plain tartan skirt. The pleated panel down one side is the whole reason this one came back with us: standing still it is heritage, walking it is something else entirely.

autumn-explorer.heading: Why we took this one
autumn-explorer.lead:
A jacket that fits nobody in particular fits almost everybody, which is the quiet trick of a boxy cut. The tie cuffs mean you can make it sharper on a day when you want it sharper.

One good jacket beats three that each cover a month. This is the one for the long stretch between a coat being too much and a knit being not enough, which in practice runs from September to November and again from March. Among cute fall fashion buys it is the piece that decides what the rest of the season looks like.
ways: City — dark denim, a seasonal knit, cuffs tied tight and sleeves pushed up.
Considered — over a midi skirt and boots, which is the better outfit of the two.
Shoulder season — over a long-sleeved tee in April, over a jumper in October.
autumn-explorer.before: Sized L and cut boxy on purpose, with room for a thick jumper underneath — a jacket that fits nobody in particular fits almost everybody. It is unlined and wind-resistant rather than warm, so treat it as a korean fashion jacket for the shoulder seasons and put a coat over it in January. The tie cuffs are the sizing on the sleeve: pull them in for a sharper line, leave them loose over a knit.
autumn-explorer.lead_base: A jacket that fits nobody in particular fits almost everybody, which is the quiet trick of a boxy cut. The tie cuffs mean you can make it sharper on a day when you want it sharper.

bear-motif-knit-vest.heading: Why we took this one
bear-motif-knit-vest.lead:
The single most asked-about thing in the shop. He is knitted in rather than printed on, so he will not crack or peel, and he is wearing a tiny hoodie of his own.

It is usually bought by somebody shopping for a niece who then keeps it, which tells you most of what you need to know. That construction is why it survives being worn properly rather than carefully — a winter of school runs and washes leaves it looking much as it arrived.
ways: Plain — over a crisp white tee.
Preppy — over a collared shirt with the collar out.
Below — jeans or a cord skirt, and nothing else with a motif on it.
bear-motif-knit-vest.before: One size. The bear is knitted into the panel rather than appliquéd on, so there is nothing to peel off in a wash — but wash it cold and dry it flat anyway, because the motif and the ground shrink at different rates. One piece of whimsy per outfit, and this spends it. Grey or beige; the beige is the softer of the two. Among cute clothes to wear it is the one bought for a niece and kept.
bear-motif-knit-vest.lead_base: The single most asked-about thing in the shop. He is knitted in rather than printed on, so he will not crack or peel, and he is wearing a tiny hoodie of his own.

beaute-angel-queens-cushion-15g-long-las.heading: Why it is on the shelf
beaute-angel-queens-cushion-15g-long-las.lead:
A cushion is the one piece of makeup worth carrying: ten seconds, no mirror ritual, no brush to clean. We stock the shade most people here actually wear rather than a wall of them.

Stocking one shade is a decision rather than an oversight: a convenience product nobody can choose between stops being one. This is makeup for a car park or a lift rather than a dressing table, and anything that makes the choice slower defeats the point of a korean cushion compact entirely.
ways: Ten seconds — two or three presses over the centre of the face, blended outwards.
Building — a second layer only where you want it, never all over.
Four o'clock — pressed over the day's makeup rather than reapplied under it.
beaute-angel-queens-cushion-15g-long-las.before: Shade #21 is the lighter of the two standard Korean shades and the one most people here wear; it is sheer enough at the edges to blend without a visible jaw line, but it will not cover a deeper skin tone. Press, do not sweep — a korean cushion compact applied with a dragging motion goes patchy. Wash the puff weekly and replace it before you replace the compact; a tired puff is the usual reason a cushion stops behaving.
beaute-angel-queens-cushion-15g-long-las.lead_base: A cushion is the one piece of makeup worth carrying: ten seconds, no mirror ritual, no brush to clean. We stock the shade most people here actually wear rather than a wall of them.

beaute-glutathione-vitamin-ampoule-balm.heading: Why it is on the shelf
beaute-glutathione-vitamin-ampoule-balm.lead:
An ampoule in a bottle stays on the bathroom shelf. In a twist-up compact it goes in a bag and gets used on the patch that needs it, which is the point of a brightening product in the first place.

Brightening is almost always aimed at something small — a shadow beside the nose, the mark a spot left behind in August. Treating a whole face for a thumbprint of skin is how a bottle disappears in three weeks with nothing to show. A korean ampoule you can aim is a cheaper product than a bottle, even at the same price.
ways: Targeted — pressed onto the sides of the nose, around the mouth, anywhere a mark is fading.
Over makeup — it sits on top of a cushion compact without moving it.
In a bag — the compact is the point; this is the korean ampoule that leaves the bathroom.
beaute-glutathione-vitamin-ampoule-balm.before: This is a targeted product rather than a routine one — a glutathione balm is for the patches you can point at, not for a whole face, and treating it as a moisturiser is the quickest way to get through it for nothing. Brightening is slow: give it six to eight weeks. Keep it out of a hot bag in summer, because a balm this soft will slump above about 30°C and will not re-form the same way.
beaute-glutathione-vitamin-ampoule-balm.lead_base: An ampoule in a bottle stays on the bathroom shelf. In a twist-up compact it goes in a bag and gets used on the patch that needs it, which is the point of a brightening product in the first place.

beaute-vita-collagen-tone-up-cream-45ml-.heading: Why it is on the shelf
beaute-vita-collagen-tone-up-cream-45ml-.lead:
Most tone-up creams are tacky enough that you only wear them once. This one finishes dewy and sits under everything else, so it reads as skin rather than as a product you put on.

Most people abandon this category after one tube, and it is almost always the finish rather than the protection that does it: tacky at ten, grey by noon. A tone up sunscreen that finishes like skin is the version people actually repurchase, which is the only measure of a sunscreen that matters in the end.
ways: No-makeup day — on its own, as the only thing on your face.
Under a cushion — as the base, where the dewy finish does the work of a primer.
Reapplied — by the clock rather than by your reflection; the brightening fades first.
beaute-vita-collagen-tone-up-cream-45ml-.before: A tone up sunscreen brightens as it goes on, which means it also needs blending at the jaw and the hairline like a base would. 45ml lasts longer than it sounds because a tone-up needs less than a chalky white cream does, but do not ration it — the protection is only as good as the quantity. If you have reacted to a korean sun cream before, patch this behind an ear for a night; the collagen and the pigment are both new variables.
beaute-vita-collagen-tone-up-cream-45ml-.lead_base: Most tone-up creams are tacky enough that you only wear them once. This one finishes dewy and sits under everything else, so it reads as skin rather than as a product you put on.

belted-shirt-dress.heading: Why we took this one
belted-shirt-dress.lead:
A self-tie belt means the waist sits where yours is rather than where a pattern cutter guessed. The skirt is full enough to move and plain enough to wear to work.

Buttons the whole way down are the second half of the purchase: open over trousers and a tee it stops being a dress at all, which is where most of the wear comes from. Four colours, and the taupe and grey are the quiet ones that go to work without being asked about.
ways: Weekday — belted, with boots.
Layered — open over wide trousers, as a long shirt.
Seasons — flat sandals in summer, tights and a boot in winter.
belted-shirt-dress.before: Alpha sizing, with the belt doing the shaping — which means the fit is forgiving and the proportion is yours to set. Four colours; the taupe and the grey are the quiet ones and the cream is the one that needs care. Worn open over trousers it stops being a dress at all, which doubles what you bought. For petite dresses casual searches it is the shape that works without an alteration.
belted-shirt-dress.lead_base: A self-tie belt means the waist sits where yours is rather than where a pattern cutter guessed. The skirt is full enough to move and plain enough to wear to work.

bonny-hill-straw-berry-collagen-heartlea.heading: Why it is on the shelf
bonny-hill-straw-berry-collagen-heartlea.lead:
Toner pads replaced bottled toner here almost overnight, because you use the right amount without thinking about it. This is the one for brightness, with enough heartleaf in it not to sting.

Bottled toner is the step most people are either wasting or skipping — a soaked cotton round takes three times what a face needs, and a tired evening takes none at all. A korean toner pad settles the question by handing you one dose. This is the brightening one of the pair, kept calm enough by the heartleaf to use daily rather than in bursts.
ways: Morning — one pad swept outwards over a cleansed face, before serum.
Targeted — laid flat on a dull forehead or a red cheek for three or four minutes.
Neck and hands — whatever is left on the pad, rather than throwing it away.
bonny-hill-straw-berry-collagen-heartlea.before: Sixty pads in the jar: two months at once a day, one at twice. A collagen toner pad exfoliates lightly as you wipe, so if you also use an acid elsewhere in your routine, do not use both on the same evening. Use the tongs rather than dipping a hand in, and press the lid down firmly — a jar left open dries from the top down and the last twenty pads are the ones that suffer.
bonny-hill-straw-berry-collagen-heartlea.lead_base: Toner pads replaced bottled toner here almost overnight, because you use the right amount without thinking about it. This is the one for brightness, with enough heartleaf in it not to sting.

bonnyhill-ampoule-mask-sheet.heading: Why it is on the shelf
bonnyhill-ampoule-mask-sheet.lead:
The quickest way to find out whether an ingredient suits you is twenty minutes with it on your face, not six weeks and a full-size bottle. Three versions, so you can test three answers.

Buying a box of ten of the wrong one is how most people conclude the category does nothing. Working through them a sachet at a time tells you what your skin wants on a bad week before anything full-size is paid for. A hydrating face mask is also the cheapest possible test of a brand.
ways: After cleansing — on a toned face, fifteen to twenty minutes and no longer.
Before an evening — the hydrating face mask an hour before you need to look awake.
Testing — one of each of the three, to find out which ingredient your skin likes.
bonnyhill-ampoule-mask-sheet.before: Twice a week is plenty; a korean sheet mask is a treatment rather than a step, and more often does not do more. Do not leave it on past twenty minutes — once the sheet dries it starts taking moisture back out of the skin. Press in what is left rather than rinsing, and follow with a moisturiser to seal it. If a particular ampoule mask stings, that is information: stop and try a different one of the three.
bonnyhill-ampoule-mask-sheet.lead_base: The quickest way to find out whether an ingredient suits you is twenty minutes with it on your face, not six weeks and a full-size bottle. Three versions, so you can test three answers.

bonnyhill-honeybee-propolis-cream.heading: Why it is on the shelf
bonnyhill-honeybee-propolis-cream.lead:
Every winter somebody comes in with skin that has stopped behaving and a routine of nine products. This is the one we hand them: thick, uncomplicated, and nothing in it trying to be clever.

Nine products and unhappy skin is the most common thing we see in January, and the fix is almost never a tenth. Propolis has been in Korean skincare for decades because it does one plain job well, and a korean moisturizer with nothing clever in it is the easiest thing to add back when you have stripped a routine to nothing.
ways: Winter nights — the last step, over a serum, warmed between the fingers first.
Rescue — the only step on a day when your skin has stopped cooperating.
Patches — in summer, on the dry areas rather than the whole face.
bonnyhill-honeybee-propolis-cream.before: This is a dry skin cream at the heavy end of a routine, and oily skin will prefer it at night only. 170ml is a large pot and it will last a season of winter evenings. Warm it between the fingers before it goes on; a propolis cream this thick drags if you apply it cold. Propolis is a bee product — if you react to honey or to bee stings, this is not the korean moisturizer for you.
bonnyhill-honeybee-propolis-cream.lead_base: Every winter somebody comes in with skin that has stopped behaving and a routine of nine products. This is the one we hand them: thick, uncomplicated, and nothing in it trying to be clever.

bonnyhill-ultra-moisturizing-heartleaf-t.heading: Why it is on the shelf
bonnyhill-ultra-moisturizing-heartleaf-t.lead:
The plainest thing on the skincare shelf and the one we restock most. No acid, no fruit, nothing to react to — which is exactly what reactive skin is looking for.

Everything else here is trying to do something to your skin. This is the one that is trying not to, which is a harder product to sell and an easier one to use. It is what we reach for in the week after a reaction, when the job is to put nothing new in front of the skin and let it get on with settling.
ways: Twice a day — one pad swept outwards over clean skin, morning and night.
On a flare — two pads laid flat over a red patch for five minutes.
Instead of serum — they leave enough essence behind that the next step is optional.
bonnyhill-ultra-moisturizing-heartleaf-t.before: This is the plainest korean toner pad we carry and that is the whole point: no acid, no fruit extract, nothing to react to. If your skin is currently unhappy with something else, a heartleaf toner is the right place to retreat to while it settles. Sixty pads — a month at twice a day. Use the tongs rather than a hand, and keep the lid pressed down; a sensitive skin toner that has dried out in the jar is no use to anybody.
bonnyhill-ultra-moisturizing-heartleaf-t.lead_base: The plainest thing on the skincare shelf and the one we restock most. No acid, no fruit, nothing to react to — which is exactly what reactive skin is looking for.

bonnyhill-ultra-moisturizing-rice-niacin.heading: Why it is on the shelf
bonnyhill-ultra-moisturizing-rice-niacin.lead:
Two actives most people were buying separately, in one pot, at the price of one of them. If your routine has grown to six steps, this is where to start cutting.

Routines grow because every problem arrives with a product attached. Cutting one back is harder, and the sensible place to start is wherever two things can become one. Niacinamide and rice extract in the same pot at the price of either is that place — a korean moisturizer that lets two bottles leave the shelf for good.
ways: Morning — after serum, under sunscreen, where it layers without pilling.
Night — as the last step over whatever you are treating with.
Simplifying — in place of two products, if your routine has grown to six steps.
bonnyhill-ultra-moisturizing-rice-niacin.before: Niacinamide is one of the few actives that gets on with almost everything else, so a niacinamide cream rarely complicates a routine that already works. 100ml is about three months at twice a day. A rice extract cream is mild enough for most skin, but if you have reacted to niacinamide at high concentrations before, patch it for a night first. This is the korean moisturizer to keep when you are cutting the rest.
bonnyhill-ultra-moisturizing-rice-niacin.lead_base: Two actives most people were buying separately, in one pot, at the price of one of them. If your routine has grown to six steps, this is where to start cutting.

brushed-check-overshirt.heading: Why we took this one
brushed-check-overshirt.lead:
Soft from the first wear rather than the fiftieth, which is the only test a flannel has to pass. Six colourways, because this is the piece people come back for in another colour.

A flannel that needs fifty washes to soften is a flannel you give up on in week three. Brushing it properly at the mill costs a little more and is the only test this garment has to pass. People come back for a second colourway, which is why we carry six of them rather than two.
ways: Buttoned — with jeans, as a shirt.
Open — over a white tee, as a light jacket.
Tied — round the waist when the afternoon warms up.
brushed-check-overshirt.before: One size and genuinely oversized, so it goes over a long-sleeved top as an October jacket. Six colours, which is more choice than most things here get — the navy and the dark brown are the quiet ones, the hot pink is not. Brushed flannel pills where a bag strap rubs; a comb twice a season fixes it. Of all our comfy cute clothes this is the one that ends up living in the back of a car, which is a compliment.
brushed-check-overshirt.lead_base: Soft from the first wear rather than the fiftieth, which is the only test a flannel has to pass. Six colourways, because this is the piece people come back for in another colour.

cat-motif-cardigan.heading: Why we took this one
cat-motif-cardigan.lead:
The cats are knitted into the body, not appliquéd on, and the contrast placket keeps the whole thing from tipping into novelty. Cream, so it goes with everything you own.

Knitting a motif into the body rather than stitching it on afterwards is the line between knitwear and novelty, and it costs more to do. At fifty-two dollars this is one of the dearer knits here, and that is where the money has gone — nothing to peel, nothing to crack, and nothing that looks cheap close up.
ways: Plain — over a white tee and straight jeans.
Preppy — over a shirt with the collar out.
Layered — under a long coat, where the motif shows at the opening.
cat-motif-cardigan.before: Alpha sizing, in cream, which goes with everything and is most of why it sells — and which also means it shows a mark, so wash it before the mark sets rather than after. The cat is knitted into the panel rather than appliquéd, so there is nothing to peel off. One decorated garment per outfit. Among aesthetic cute clothes it is the piece that reads as charm rather than as costume.
cat-motif-cardigan.lead_base: The cats are knitted into the body, not appliquéd on, and the contrast placket keeps the whole thing from tipping into novelty. Cream, so it goes with everything you own.

celestial-midnight-a-line-gown.heading: Why we took this one
celestial-midnight-a-line-gown.lead:
Long dresses are usually bought for one evening and then hang there. This one is knit on top and corduroy below, so it is warm enough to actually wear in the months you are invited to things.

Most are built for a heated room in July and then bought for an evening in December, which is why they hang unworn afterwards. Sleeves, a skirt with weight in it and a waistband that stays put change that arithmetic — a korean fashion formal dress you can be cold in is one you will wear more than once.
ways: Evening — a heel, a flat gold earring, and nothing at the neck.
Winter — a long wool coat over it and opaque tights underneath.

Yuja has been in Korean skincare for decades, long before brightening became a category in the West, and it is the ingredient people reach for when an acid has been too much. Slow is the trade: six to eight weeks before anything is worth judging, and a texture light enough that you keep going.
ways: Morning — under sunscreen, where the light texture does not pill.
Night — as the last step, over a toner.
Paired — with the matching yuja toner, if you want the full routine.
tenzero-brightening-yuja-cream.before: Brightening is slow by nature — give a yuja cream six to eight weeks before deciding anything. The texture is light enough to layer, which is unusual for a brightening korean moisturizer, and makes it the easier one to fit into a routine that already works.
tenzero-brightening-yuja-cream.lead_base: Yuja is the Korean citron — the fruit in the tea — and it is the gentle route to brightness without the sting of an acid. There is a matching toner if you want the pair.

tenzero-brightening-yuja-toner-200-ml.heading: Why it is on the shelf
tenzero-brightening-yuja-toner-200-ml.lead:
Vitamin C without the oxidation problems or the sting. It is the easiest thing to add to a routine that already works, which is the only kind of addition worth making.

Vitamin C is the usual answer for brightness and it is a difficult ingredient: it oxidises in the bottle, it stings on the way in, and half of it is wasted before you learn to like it. This is the easier road to the same place, and it complicates nothing that is already working.
ways: Twice a day — a few drops pressed into clean skin, before serum.
Instead of vitamin C — without the sting or the oxidation.
Paired — with the matching cream, though either works alone.
tenzero-brightening-yuja-toner-200-ml.before: 200ml is a generous bottle for a toner and will last a season at twice a day. tenzero-brightening-yuja-toner-200-ml.lead_base: Vitamin C without the oxidation problems or the sting. It is the easiest thing to add to a routine that already works, which is the only kind of addition worth making.

the-abstract-pleated-statement-skirt.heading: Why we took this one
the-abstract-pleated-statement-skirt.lead:
Standing still it is graphic; walking, the pleats keep the pattern moving, and that is the entire reason the skirt exists. Wear nothing else with a pattern on it.

An abstract print on a flat skirt is wallpaper. Put it on pleats and the pattern folds in and out of itself as you cross a room, which no amount of printing can imitate. That is the entire reason the skirt exists, and the reason it is worth owning one piece like it rather than three merely patterned ones.
ways: Day — combat boots and a plain black knit.
Evening — heels and nothing else competing.
Winter — a long black coat, so the sheer panel shows below the hem.
the-abstract-pleated-statement-skirt.before: Length 32 inches, cut to a 25–26 inch waist, with a wide black elastic waistband stretching to 30 and a hidden side zip keeping the front flat. Fully lined above the sheer panel. One colour on top, always — this korean fashion skirt cannot share a page with another pattern. Dry clean, or cold wash in a mesh bag hung by the waistband; never fold it across the pleats.
the-abstract-pleated-statement-skirt.lead_base: Standing still it is graphic; walking, the pleats keep the pattern moving, and that is the entire reason the skirt exists. Wear nothing else with a pattern on it.

the-alabaster-high-rise-sculpt-trousers.heading: Why we took this one
the-alabaster-high-rise-sculpt-trousers.lead:
A 27 inch inseam and a small flare, which is a combination most ranges do not bother with. Sharp, and not black, which is rarer than it should be.

Petite ranges tend to offer the safe shapes: straight, black, narrow. A flare is treated as something taller people do, which is nonsense — it is a proportion, and a proportion works at any height if the inseam is right. A blue-grey is the other rarity here, and it does more next to cream and camel than black ever will.
ways: Tucked — a ribbed knit in, with a pointed flat.
Untucked — a shirt left out, with a block heel.
Tonal — anything in the same cool family on top, which the blue-grey takes well.

the-alabaster-high-rise-sculpt-trousers.lead_base: A 27 inch inseam and a small flare, which is a combination most ranges do not bother with. Sharp, and not black, which is rarer than it should be.

the-artisan-chevron-knit-co-ord.heading: Why we took this one
the-artisan-chevron-knit-co-ord.lead:
The chevron border is what makes it look designed rather than merely matched. The vest layers over a shirt or a polo neck, so the set does not have to stay a set.

Vest — over a white shirt with jeans.
Skirt — with a fine knit tucked in, as a korean fashion skirt in its own right.

the-artisan-chevron-knit-co-ord.lead_base: The chevron border is what makes it look designed rather than merely matched. The vest layers over a shirt or a polo neck, so the set does not have to stay a set.

the-artisan-pleat-midi-skirt.heading: Why we took this one
the-artisan-pleat-midi-skirt.lead:
The stripe panel is set off-centre on purpose — it drags the eye diagonally and makes a pleated skirt look drawn rather than bought. One plain top is all it needs.

ways: Cream — a cream knit tucked in with a flat boot.
Black — a plain black top and a heel, letting the stripe panel do everything.
Summer — a white tee and a flat sandal.
the-artisan-pleat-midi-skirt.before: One size, with the waistband at the natural waist and the hem below the knee on most people. the-artisan-pleat-midi-skirt.lead_base: The stripe panel is set off-centre on purpose — it drags the eye diagonally and makes a pleated skirt look drawn rather than bought. One plain top is all it needs.

the-avenue-crest-long-sleeve-dress.heading: Why we took this one
the-avenue-crest-long-sleeve-dress.lead:
The contrast trim runs in one unbroken line from collar to hem, which is where the height comes from. It is the dress for a week that needs one thing you can wear for twelve hours.

A vertical line is the oldest trick in tailoring and the cheapest to execute, which is why it is usually done badly — a printed stripe, a seam that stops at the waist. One continuous trim from collar to hem is the version that works, and it is what makes this a korean fashion formal dress you can wear on an ordinary Tuesday.
ways: Work — a low heel and nothing at the neck.
Winter — flat boots and a long coat.
Evening — the same dress, a better shoe, and one earring that catches light.

A korean fashion formal dress restrained enough to wear weekly.
the-avenue-crest-long-sleeve-dress.lead_base: The contrast trim runs in one unbroken line from collar to hem, which is where the height comes from. It is the dress for a week that needs one thing you can wear for twelve hours.

the-belted-wrap-knit-vest.heading: Why we took this one
the-belted-wrap-knit-vest.lead:

ways: Weekday — over a long-sleeved tee and straight jeans, belted loosely, with a flat boot.

Weekend — open and long over a thin knit and a slim skirt, with the belt left in a drawer.

the-belted-wrap-knit-vest.lead_base: A third piece is the hardest thing to buy well, and most of them are either a blazer that needs a shirt under it or a cardigan that reads as a dressing gown. This one ties, so it has whatever shape you give it that morning.

the-bronze-helm-explorer-slim-fit-jeans.heading: Why we took this one
the-bronze-helm-explorer-slim-fit-jeans.lead:
Slim rather than skinny, which is the cut that has survived every swing of the last decade. The whiskering looks like wear rather than like a machine making a point about it.

Wide legs and skinny legs both go in and out; a slim straight has not been wrong in ten years and will not be next year. ways: Boots — ankle boots and a tucked-in knit.
Trainers — with an untucked shirt, for a Saturday.
Loafers — with a blazer, which a slim leg takes and a wide one does not.

the-bronze-helm-explorer-slim-fit-jeans.lead_base: Slim rather than skinny, which is the cut that has survived every swing of the last decade. The whiskering looks like wear rather than like a machine making a point about it.

the-brunello-cucinelli-monili-straight-l.heading: Why we took this one
the-brunello-cucinelli-monili-straight-l.lead:
The beading is set into the outside seam and catches the light when you move, which is the entire ornament on an otherwise plain trouser. A slim leg would crowd it; this one does not.

For petite clothes for work that is the difference between a trouser for one occasion and one for a season.

Sharp — a black polo neck, which throws the beading into relief.
Evening — a heel, because the stripe runs to the hem and wants to be seen.

the-brunello-cucinelli-monili-straight-l.lead_base: The beading is set into the outside seam and catches the light when you move, which is the entire ornament on an otherwise plain trouser. A slim leg would crowd it; this one does not.

the-burgundy-knot-sheath-dress.heading: Why we took this one
the-burgundy-knot-sheath-dress.lead:
The knot at the waist is what takes the severity out of a pencil line, and it is the only thing happening on the dress. Desk in the morning, restaurant at night, one change of earrings.

A sheath is the most formal shape a dress can take and the one most likely to read as severe, which is why so few of them get worn twice. Softening it with a single detail rather than a print keeps it in the wardrobe — and burgundy is the colour that carries an evening without announcing one.
ways: Work — a court shoe and a single necklace.
Dinner — the same dress, a change of earrings, a better bag.
Winter — opaque tights and a wool coat rather than a padded one.

Among petite dresses special occasion options, the one you will wear more than once.
the-burgundy-knot-sheath-dress.lead_base: The knot at the waist is what takes the severity out of a pencil line, and it is the only thing happening on the dress. Desk in the morning, restaurant at night, one change of earrings.

the-chic-minimalist-knit-blazer.heading: Why we took this one
the-chic-minimalist-knit-blazer.lead:
The most expensive thing in the shop and the one still in rotation in five years. Seventy per cent wool, handmade, and it holds a shoulder line without a scrap of padding.

Weekend — over a tee and jeans, which is where a knit blazer beats a structured one.

the-chic-minimalist-knit-blazer.lead_base: The most expensive thing in the shop and the one still in rotation in five years. Seventy per cent wool, handmade, and it holds a shoulder line without a scrap of padding.

the-chic-minimalist-trench-dress.heading: Why we took this one
the-chic-minimalist-trench-dress.lead:
A coat pattern cut as a dress, which is half of what makes the Korean silhouette recognisable. The khaki-olive takes black, cream, brown and denim without an argument.

Winter — belted, with a long coat over the top and tights underneath.

the-chic-minimalist-trench-dress.lead_base: A coat pattern cut as a dress, which is half of what makes the Korean silhouette recognisable. The khaki-olive takes black, cream, brown and denim without an argument.

the-city-fringe-knit-skirt.lead:
A pencil skirt that behaves like a knit is a rare thing and this is the best one we have had. The fringe swings a half-beat behind you and does all the work.

A korean fashion skirt that behaves like tailoring and wears like a knit, which is the whole argument for it among petite clothes for work.
the-city-fringe-knit-skirt.lead_base: A pencil skirt that behaves like a knit is a rare thing and this is the best one we have had. The fringe swings a half-beat behind you and does all the work.

Proper cables — raised and ropey, warm because of it rather than for decoration. The warmest thing we sell and the one most likely to be worn until it falls apart.

the-coziest-classic-heritage-cable-knit-.lead_base: Proper cables — raised and ropey, warm because of it rather than for decoration. The warmest thing we sell and the one most likely to be worn until it falls apart.

the-deconstructed-chic-trench-skirt-set.lead_base: The strongest thing we have ever stocked: a trench coat cut off at the waist with a mini skirt under it. Apart, the jacket goes over jeans and the skirt under a knit.

the-executive-pleat-trench-dress.heading: Why we took this one
